# Where to find Gatling Plasma Mod Plans in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 4, 2024
- 4 min read

Updated: Jan 12, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_544c8f8cae6944b4845e1d93c39856d4~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

**Prerequisites**

You must know the Plan: Gatling Plasma before any of its mod plans will start to drop.

 **Plan: Gatling Plasma**

- MODUS - Armory Terminal (100% chance)
- Low chance to drop from: 
 - World Containers
 - Crowned Creatures
 - Treasure maps
 - Weapon Plan World Spawn Locations

**Additional Information:**

The weapon Gatling Plasma can also be purchased from MODUS - Armory Terminal (100% chance for MODUS to have the weapon available for purchase).

Once obtained, the weapon can be scrapped to learn some of its mods.

Each time you scrap a Gatling Plasma, there is a chance to unlock one of its mods, with the chance for each specific mod depending on its rarity.

This process may require scrapping multiple weapons to learn all possible mods.

If you are looking for the Yellow Box Mod versions of the Gatling Plasma Mods, they can be found in the same vendors as the __Enclave Plasma Gun Yellow Box Mods.__ 

__Mod List__ 

__Receiver__

**Calibrated Capacitor**

Plan Name: Gatling Plasma Calibrated Capacitor

Description: Superior critical shot damage.

Tradeable Plan: Yes

Obtained by:

- Nuke Card Cargobot Crate (0.50% drop rate)
- Government Supply Crate (U.S. Government Supply Requisition Holotape) (0.50% drop rate)
- Event: Collision Course (final government supply drop) (0.50% drop rate)
- Chance for the Yellow Box Mod to spawn in the Cranberry Bog region (0.31%)
- Chance for the Yellow Box Mod to spawn in the Mire region

**Gamma Wave Emitter**

Plan Name: Gatling Plasma Gamma Wave Emitter

Description: Adds burning damage. Adds better burning damage.

Tradeable Plan: Yes

Obtained by:

- Nuke Card Cargobot Crate (0.50% drop rate)
- Government Supply Crate (U.S. Government Supply Requisition Holotape) (0.50% drop rate)
- Event: Collision Course (final government supply drop) (0.50% drop rate)
- Chance for the Yellow Box Mod to spawn in the Cranberry Bog region (0.31%)
- Chance for the Yellow Box Mod to spawn in the Mire region

**Prime**

Plan Name: Gatling Plasma Prime Receiver

Description: +65% Damage to Scorched, uses Ultracite ammo

Tradeable Plan: Yes

Obtained by:

- **Scorchbeast Queen:** Defeating the Scorchbeast Queen provides a chance to drop an unlearned Prime Receiver plan. The probability of receiving a specific plan is calculated as 1 divided by (38 minus the number of Prime Receiver plans already learned).
- **Regular Scorchbeasts:** These enemies have a 5% chance of dropping a Prime Receiver plan, following the same probability calculation as above.

**Standard**

Description: None

Tradeable Plan: No

Obtained by:

- Known by default
